crop.notes: Full 'Sporting' report of the Mace-Coburn fight; ends at the 'Trotting' subhead.

ocr.notes: Mostly accurate with scattered errors ('Col. Rufus Nant' for Hunt).

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that Tom Allen and Jim Cusick seconded Jem Mace against Joe Coburn at Montgomery Station, Mississippi. The referee declared the fight a draw after three hours and thirty-eight minutes.

metadata.notes: Page header reads 'The Missouri Republican--St. Louis, December 2, 1871'. The St. Louis Republic name dates from 1888.

facts.fact: Allen and Jim Cusick seconded Jem Mace against Joe Coburn at Montgomery Station, Mississippi, about forty miles from New Orleans; the referee, Col. Rufus Hunt, declared the fight a draw after 3 hours 38 minutes
Allen travelled from New Orleans on the special excursion train to the Mace-Coburn fight ground

notes: Same report as 441 (Daily Missouri Democrat, same day).
